items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: He came down and played with me; and then I had John Fields, a white fellow, on bass.

ctx.x: How many pieces were there in that band?
Rex was living up in New York... and I sent for him. He came down and played with me; and then I had John Fields, a white fellow, on bass. I don't know, it was just a good band, very good band...
